Title: Vitamin D Self Test
Body (HTML):
Vitamin D is essential for bone health, immune function, and muscle strength. Deficiency is extremely common in India due to indoor lifestyles. Our test detects 25-hydroxy Vitamin D levels via a lateral flow immunoassay from a finger-prick sample.

  • Results in 10 min
  • Finger-prick
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Shade card
SEO Description: Check your Vitamin D levels at home in minutes.

Title: Vitamin B12 Test
Body (HTML):
Vitamin B12 is vital for nerve function, red blood cell formation, and DNA synthesis. Over 80% of Indian vegetarians are B12 deficient. Our test detects deficiency early so you can act.

  • Results in 10 min
  • B12 detection
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Finger-prick
SEO Description: Check B12 levels — crucial for nerve health.

Title: Iron Deficiency (Ferritin) Test
Body (HTML):
Iron deficiency affects over 50% of Indian women. Our test detects Ferritin — the protein that stores iron. Low Ferritin is the earliest indicator, even before anemia develops.

  • Results in 10 min
  • Ferritin detection
  • CE & IVD certified
  • No lab visit
SEO Description: Detect iron deficiency anemia quickly at home.

Title: TSH Thyroid Test
Body (HTML):
TSH is the key marker for thyroid function. Abnormal levels indicate hypo/hyperthyroidism — extremely common in India. Our test uses lateral flow technology from a finger-prick sample.

  • Results in 10 min
  • TSH detection
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Clinically accurate

Title: HbA1c Diabetes Test
Body (HTML):
HbA1c reflects your average blood sugar over the past 2-3 months. India is the diabetes capital of the world with 100M+ diabetics. This test helps monitor glucose control without fasting.

  • Results in 10 min
  • HbA1c detection
  • CE & IVD certified
  • 3-month average

Title: PSA Prostate Test
Body (HTML):
PSA is produced by the prostate gland. Elevated levels may indicate enlargement, inflammation, or cancer. Regular screening is recommended for men over 50 (or 40 with family history).

  • Results in 10 min
  • PSA marker
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Men's health
SEO Description: Screen for prostate health at home.

Title: CRP Inflammation Test
Body (HTML):
C-Reactive Protein (CRP) is produced by the liver in response to inflammation. Elevated CRP can indicate infections, autoimmune diseases, or cancer. A key marker for overall health assessment.

  • Results in 10 min
  • CRP marker
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Inflammation screening
SEO Description: Detect inflammation levels in your body.

Title: Dengue NS1 + IgG/IgM Test
Body (HTML):
Dengue is common in India during monsoon. Our combo test detects NS1 antigen (active infection in first 5 days) and IgG/IgM antibodies (current or past infection) from a single sample.

  • Results in 15 min
  • NS1 + Antibody
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Early detection

Title: Malaria Pf/Pv Test
Body (HTML):
Malaria remains endemic in many parts of India. Our rapid test differentiates between P. falciparum (the more dangerous species) and P. vivax from a finger-prick blood sample.

  • Results in 15 min
  • Pf & Pv detection
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Rapid screening
SEO Description: Rapid malaria screening for P. falciparum & P. vivax.

Title: Procalcitonin Test
Body (HTML):
Procalcitonin (PCT) is elevated in bacterial infections and sepsis. It helps differentiate bacterial from viral infections, guiding antibiotic use. Critical for early sepsis detection.

  • Results in 15 min
  • PCT marker
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Sepsis screening
SEO Description: Early marker for bacterial infections and sepsis.

Title: Troponin I Test
Body (HTML):
Cardiac Troponin I is released when heart muscle is damaged. Elevated levels strongly suggest heart attack or cardiac injury. This rapid test can be life-saving in emergencies.

  • Results in 15 min
  • cTnI marker
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Cardiac screening
SEO Description: Rapid cardiac marker for heart attack screening.

Title: Troponin T Test
Body (HTML):
Troponin T is another cardiac-specific marker released during heart muscle damage. Combined with clinical symptoms, it helps in rapid assessment of acute coronary events.

  • Results in 15 min
  • cTnT marker
  • CE & IVD certified
  • Cardiac emergency
